svg.text: NIST SP 800-90B style health testing of whole audio frames — low-entropy segments are refused, not rewritten.
output = only the kept frames, concatenated
per block, compute byte-histogram uniformity statistic z
|z| ≤ zlim → keep the block |z| > zlim → discard
the gate never rewrites, whitens or expands data
Low-entropy frames are discarded; the surviving frames form a uniform stream with no rewriting.
